notes: Parent is the glucose-adapted (GMOS) MG1655 ALE strain, used as reference/control. KO strains are deletions; ALE descendants of the KOs labelled evolved_isolate with the deleted genes listed. The medium of the RNA-seq cultures is not stated (only that the parent was adapted to glucose minimal media), so medium/carbon/temperature/oxygen left out; 'batch' culture type stated but shaking not described, so culture_mode left out.

growth_phase.q: Total RNA was extracted from mid-log phase culture for RNA-Seq library preparation.

strain_group.q: E. coli K-12 MG1655 strains subjected to adaptive laboratory evolution

strain_name.q: a strain of E. coli K-12 MG1655 that had already been previously adapted for growth on glucose minimal media

treatment.q: RNA-seq profiles of the original glucose-adapted strain, the 2 deletion strains, and 4 laboratory-evolved strains from each deletion are included in duplicate.

inducer_added.q: RNA-seq profiles of the original glucose-adapted strain, the 2 deletion strains, and 4 laboratory-evolved strains from each deletion are included in duplicate.

global_regulator_perturbed.q: Either isochorismate synthase (menF) or isochorismate synthase AND chorismate lyase (ubiC) was deleted

assay_class.q: The ribosomal RNA was removed using an Illumina Ribo-Zero rRNA removal kit for Gram-negative bacteria.
